summary: The chunk provides a comprehensive list of abbreviations relevant to various medical conditions and terms, including types of carcinomas such as adenocarcinoma (ADC) and cholangiocarcinoma (CHC) [C1:S1|PMC11503264|450]. Additional abbreviations include terms related to pathology and genetics, such as cytokeratin (CK) and protein kinase A (PKA) [C1:S2|PMC12232248|752]. Furthermore, it includes abbreviations for neurological conditions like amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) [C1:S3|PMC12516176|1076; C1:S4|PMC12516176|1114].

rules.condition: IF a medical term is abbreviated
rules.action: THEN refer to the provided list of abbreviations for clarification
